SELECT eqb.id, eqb.`name`, eqb.theme_id, eqb.question_type, eqb.question_content, eqb.score, eqb.answer_analysis, th.`name` as theme_name FROM exam_question_bank eqb LEFT JOIN theme th on eqb.theme_id = th.id
and (eqb.name like concat('%',#{query.keyword},'%') or th.name like concat('%',#{query.keyword},'%') )
order by eqb.create_time desc
